_comment: Category -> HS Code + Country of Origin lookup, transcribed from Neil's 'HS Code and Country of Origin .xlsx' (2026-08-12). Neil's rule: the HS Code is always constant per category; Country of Origin can vary within a category for the 3 categories he flagged. Three distinct handling mechanisms for that variance, per category: 'needs_manual_review' (true = never auto-fill country, no rule exists yet -- Lampwork Beads), 'sku_prefix_rules' (a real per-SKU rule exists -- Seed Beads), or a plain 'note' (the variance is about a DIFFERENT sub-item than what's actually onboarded today, so the default is safe to auto-apply as-is -- Tools & Stringing Materials, where only Leather Cord is onboarded and its country is confirmed). Keys are Neil's own category label text (cleaned), used as the match target from spreadsheet_type_id/collection -- see HS_COI_CATEGORY_MAP in app.py for that cross-reference. country_code is the Shopify CountryCode enum value (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), verified live against the real Shopify schema.

Lampwork Beads.note: Some lampwork beads are also from India (Yair's note on the sheet) -- no per-SKU rule given, unlike Seed Beads below. Do NOT bulk-apply PROC to this category without checking with Yair/Neil which specific products are India-origin first. Sheet also notes a SKU range for this category: P12050 - P12091.
Lampwork Beads.sku_range_note: P12050 - P12091 (per Neil's category label text itself)

Seed Beads.note: P120xx-prefixed color/style numbers are PROC (China); I0xxx-prefixed numbers are India, checked against color_number/factory_style by app.py before falling back to the Czech Republic default. Every Seed Beads batch onboarded so far (6/0 and 10/0) uses plain numeric color codes matching neither prefix, so Czech Republic has applied cleanly to all of them to date.

Metal Beads.note: Neil's sheet note just labels this row 'Aluminum Filigree Beads' -- the Metal Beads collection currently = Filigree Beads (the only type onboarded there so far), not a stated COI exception.

Metal Buttons.note: Neil, 2026-08-12: Buttons will get more sub-categories later -- Rhinestone Buttons (Czech Republic) coming to the site, possibly Czech Glass Buttons in stock too. Neither has its own HS code yet (buttons are a different HS category than loose rhinestones/beads, don't assume 7018-10-2000). Get the real HS code from Neil when either is actually onboarded -- not needed yet, only Metal Buttons is live.

Tools & Stringing Materials.note: Leather Cord specifically is confirmed India -- matches the default here directly, safe to auto-apply to the live Leather Cord products (the only type onboarded under this category so far). Neil's note: 'other stringing materials can be from different countries' -- if a non-Leather-Cord stringing material is onboarded later, give it its own confirmed country before relying on this India default for it.
